Classes for Wednesday, September 9, 2026 have been suspended in some areas due to heavy rains and flooding.
Metro Manila
Caloocan City - no face-to-face classes, all levels, public and private. Alternative Delivery Mode to be implemented
Quezon City - face-to-face classes suspended, all levels, public and private. Alternative Delivery Modes of Learning to be implemented
REGION III - CENTRAL LUZON
Pampanga
San Simon - all levels, public and private (maliban sa Concepcion Integrated School) September 7-11, 2026.
